Loading Eucalypt occurrences
```{r}
library(sp)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

eucalypt_occ <- read.csv("data/euc_coords.csv", header=T)
eucalypt_occ <- eucalypt_occ %>% drop_na()

coords <- cbind(eucalypt_occ$decimalLongitude, eucalypt_occ$decimalLatitude)

euc_sp <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string=CRS("+init=epsg:4326"))

```


Loading precipitation rasters from worldclim
```{r}
library(raster)

MAP <- raster("data/MAP.tif")
MAT <- raster("data/MAT.tif")
seasonality <- raster("data/seasonality.tif")
wet_quarter <- raster("data/wet_quarter.tif")
dry_quarter <- raster("data/dry_quarter.tif")

```


Extracting climate data from points
```{r}
eucalypt_occ$MAP <- raster::extract(MAP, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$MAT <- raster::extract(MAT, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$seasonality <- raster::extract(seasonality, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$wet_quarter <- raster::extract(wet_quarter, euc_sp, method='simple')
eucalypt_occ$dry_quarter <- raster::extract(dry_quarter, euc_sp, method='simple')

eucalypt_sum <- eucalypt_occ %>% 
  group_by(scientificName) %>% 
  summarise(MAP=mean(MAP, na.rm=T), 
            MAT=mean(MAT, na.rm=T),
            seasonality=mean(seasonality, na.rm=T),
            wet_quarter=mean(wet_quarter, na.rm=T),
            dry_quarter=mean(dry_quarter, na.rm=T))
```

Filtering species in database
```{r}
euc_database <- read.csv("data/database_namematched.csv", header=T)

climate_prefs <- eucalypt_sum %>% filter(scientificName %in% euc_database$current_name)
```

Plotting distributions of climate preferences 
```{r}
hist(climate_prefs$MAP)
hist(climate_prefs$MAT)
hist(climate_prefs$seasonality)
hist(climate_prefs$wet_quarter)
hist(climate_prefs$dry_quarter)
```
